info.description: The Loyalty Tier Retrieval API allows businesses to access information regarding their loyalty program tiers. This endpoint provides details about various loyalty tiers that customers can achieve based on their engagement and spending. Typical consumers of this API include developers who are integrating loyalty functionality into customer management systems or mobile apps. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance customer experiences and foster loyalty through informed tier-based interactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about the loyalty tiers available in the system, including benefits and eligibility criteria for each tier.
